newsitem.title: USA: Harken Energy sets Colombian seismic effort.
newsitem.headline: Harken Energy sets Colombian seismic effort.

text.p: Harken Energy Corp said Tuesday it is commencing a program to acquire some 500 kilometers of new seismic data to further evaluate the company's Colombian acreage in both the Cambulos and Bocachico Association contract areas.

This new seismic program is designed to develop new geologic prospects, as well as to more clearly delineate the current prospects which have been defined through the reprocessing and interpretation of the 1,500 kilometers of existing seismic data shot between 1978 and 1994.

The modern acquisition parameters should provide a sharper focus on Cretaceous objectives, which have been the subject of recent major discoveries in the area, and deeper geological horizons as yet unexplored, Harken explained in a statement.
When the new program is completed, Harken said, it will have an average line density of one line for every two kilometers over some 500,000 acres in the Bocachico and Cambulos contract areas.
